coverage: Targeted supplemental German-language discovery across all 16 federal states and separate modality and trial searches. Does not re-verify the full inherited practice roster or prove national exhaustiveness.

changes.name: Equinox Healthcare – Strahlentherapiezentrum
changes.finding: On-site linear-accelerator treatment for dogs and cats. The center describes IMRT/VMAT and electron treatment; definitive and palliative protocols are planned individually. Owners and referring veterinarians can contact the center directly.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Dr. Jochen Schulze Lammers
changes.finding: On-site superficial tumor irradiation in dogs and cats, limited to skin and subcutaneous or otherwise accessible superficial sites. The clinic separately lists chemotherapy and tumor removal. Call for an appointment.

changes.name: Kleintierklinik Ettlingen
changes.finding: The clinic explicitly administers chemotherapy under multiple protocols. Owners can arrange an appointment by telephone. The general oncology overview mentions radiation but does not establish local delivery.

changes.name: Tierärztliche Klinik Würzburg Reichenberg
changes.finding: The branch service list explicitly includes oncology with chemotherapy and tumor surgery. Phone appointments at the Reichenberg treatment address.

changes.name: VETPraxis für Kleintiere – Adriana Munteanu
changes.finding: The practice describes outpatient chemotherapy for dogs and cats. Radiation is through Equinox Healthcare in Linsengericht. The provider advertises an online oncology second opinion on its own service page.

changes.name: Kleintierpraxis Findorff – Dr. Jasmin-Janina Biege
changes.finding: Local soft-tissue surgery includes tumor removal. Public appointment telephone is listed.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Poppenbüttel
changes.finding: Local soft-tissue surgery includes tumor excision. Telephone contact is listed.

changes.name: VetPraxis – Tierarzt Krzysztof Sliwinski
changes.finding: The surgery page explicitly lists tumor operations and the Tharandter Straße practice address. Appointments by telephone.

changes.name: Kleintierpraxis Dr. Melfsen-Jessen
changes.finding: Tumor surgery is explicitly listed among locally performed operations. Telephone or online appointment request.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Isernhagen – Dr. Claudia Vollbrecht
changes.finding: Local surgery includes tumor operations. The official service page lists the clinic phone and address.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Dr. Una Mathews
changes.finding: Tumor operations are explicitly listed at this Potsdam address. Call the practice for intake.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Dr. Matthias Herzberg
changes.finding: Local surgical services include tumor operations. The practice offers consultations by telephone appointment.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Dr. Süß
changes.finding: The owned surgery page explicitly offers tumor operations and lists the treatment address and appointment telephone.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Malsch
changes.finding: The Malsch surgery page lists tumor removal. The separately named Karlsruhe-Durlach sister practice has its own service allocation.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Robin Louis – Kleintierpraxis
changes.finding: Small-animal surgery includes tumor excision with histology at the Karcherstraße location. The separate Mainzer Straße address is not used for this listing.

changes.name: Tierklinik Hofheim
changes.finding: Local chemotherapy, oncologic surgery and linear-accelerator radiation. Conventional and stereotactic radiation are available; stereotactic protocols are considered for selected tumors based on site and size. Owner and referring-vet appointments by phone or online.

changes.name: VetSpezial – Zentrum für Kleintiermedizin
changes.finding: On-site outpatient chemotherapy, RapidArc radiation and tumor surgery. Request an appointment and bring prior reports.

changes.name: LMU Kleintierklinik – Onkologie
changes.finding: Dogs and cats. Chemotherapy, tumor surgery, electrochemotherapy and photodynamic therapy. The current radiation service is limited to selected superficial tumors, operative beds, rostral oral lesions and limb palliation. Brain, thorax, spine, pelvis, neck and most deep head tumors are outside current radiation capability. Oncology appointments by phone or email.

changes.name: Tierarztpraxis Am Westend
changes.finding: The current contact page lists Heerstraße 18–20, 14052 Berlin. Oncology including chemotherapy is available by prior appointment. The published telephone number is unchanged.

Does the clinic currently offer PDT? Its official case article establishes prior treatment, but current intake remains unconfirmed.
Is I-131 offered for confirmed malignant thyroid carcinoma? The current owner page is for feline hyperthyroidism.
No named recruiting German treatment site or current patient-enrollment route confirmed.
Research described without public owner intake for an anticancer protocol. Separately, the commercial service needs disease-specific evidence review.

trial_outcome: No new publicly verified German anticancer treatment protocol with current owner enrollment. The LMU Palladia thyroid-study link currently displays osteosarcoma pain-block content. Neither route establishes a new anticancer intervention.
